In Brief
Late Entrant Takes The Week. BruceBall, which joined the
competition at Gameweek 3, scored 79 points and out-scored all
twenty other clubs. It still sits at the foot of the table, which is what
happens when you arrive two weeks late.
Wildcard Played, Twenty-Nine Points Benched. El Cochiloco
activated the Wildcard and left 29 points on the bench, the largest
single waste of the weekend. The Wildcard remains a fine chip. The
bench was not part of the plan.
Five Transfers, Sixteen Points Lost. captain bruno made five
moves and paid a sixteen-point deduction, finishing the gameweek
on 56. Five new footballers returned a combined 22 points. The
arithmetic is not discussed in polite company.
Palmer Captained, Palmer Delivers, Bench Delivers More. fc rtw
doubled Cole Palmer for sixteen points and a gameweek total of 70.
Twenty points sat on the bench regardless.
CORRECT IONS
A previous edition suggested the summit was under threat. Bart’s
Team now leads by eight points. This newspaper has revised its
position and its sense of occasion.
Isak was named captain by Camp Nou Way. He did not play, and the
armband passed to the vice-captain by rule. This is not a correction so
much as a reminder.
BruceBall’s total re flects four gameweeks, not six. Any comparison
with the rest of the table should be conducted at your own risk.
